# Internet Archive

> Internet Archive is a digital library providing free access to millions of books, texts, audio, and video files with tools for downloading, uploading, and preserving digital content.

The Internet Archive is a nonprofit organization dedicated to universal access to knowledge and digital preservation. It maintains vast collections of digitized materials across multiple languages and formats, and provides comprehensive documentation for users to access and contribute content.

## Getting Started

- [Downloading – A Basic Guide](https://help.archive.org/help/downloading-a-basic-guide/): Guide to downloading content from Internet Archive using wget and command-line tools
- [Uploading – A Basic Guide](https://help.archive.org/help/uploading-a-basic-guide/): Tutorial for uploading files to archive.org with metadata and account setup

## Collections

- [Хрестоматія по українській літературі. Ч. 1](https://archive.org/details/sumtsov1918): Ukrainian literature chrestomathy by Sumtsov (1918) with folk and old literature texts
